concept.concept: Minimalist design reading 'Fueled by Coffee and the Audacity of 28 Eight-Year-Olds' in clean layered typography
concept.audience: Elementary school teachers who bond over shared classroom chaos humor
concept.rationale: Teacher appreciation gifting is perennial and the holiday season amplifies it; hyper-specific number reference makes the audience feel seen; typography-only execution keeps production cost low; strong shareable social angle drives organic discovery; one of the more differentiated teacher concepts in a crowded niche

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Fueled by Coffee and the Audacity of 28 Eight-Year-Olds" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a steaming coffee mug tilted slightly, with bold simple geometric shapes forming a playful starburst burst behind it. Solid color blocks: warm burgundy, cream white, charcoal gray, and one accent gold. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Centered composition on a plain light gray background with generous margins. The design reads as clean, modern, and screen-print ready. Keep all elements connected and away from edges.
design.text_on_design: Fueled by Coffee and the Audacity of 28 Eight-Year-Olds
design.style: Minimalist flat vector with bold geometric mug illustration. Text in two layered sizes: main phrase in bold modern sans-serif, stacked horizontally with 'Fueled by Coffee' slightly larger and 'and the Audacity of 28 Eight-Year-Olds' in a smaller complementary weight below. All type centered below the mug illustration. Screen-print aesthetic, high contrast, sharp clean edges, no decorative flourishes.
